findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：公司配合多項政府調查；就公司所知，沒有任何機關在進行中的調查裡認定有不當行為，但無法預測結果，若 SEC、司法部或其他機關日後採取法律行動，可能面臨責任、罰款與限制性制裁。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We are cooperating with certain government investigations as discussed in Note 13, Commitments and Contingencies, to the consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. To our knowledge, no government agency in any such ongoing investigation has concluded that any wrongdoing occurred.

findings.claim: NHTSA 對 Tesla FSD 的調查延長，回覆期限延至 2026-02-23
findings.source: HeyGoTrade: Tesla FSD Probe: NHTSA Grants 5-Week Breathing Room
findings.excerpt: Gotrade News - Tesla just scored a five-week extension from US regulators regarding its Full Self-Driving (FSD) investigation. This gives the EV giant much-needed breathing room to address ongoing safety concerns. Key Takeaways: NHTSA pushed the FSD response deadline to February 23.
